data.narrative:
NextSilicon, led by founder Elad Raz, is a Series B-stage company in the AI & Software sector that has raised $200M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with peer companies including Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B), Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), and Together AI ($8.3B, Series A).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $200M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B progression, implying a $380M valuation. The Peer-Median method benchmarks against six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, yielding a median valuation of $11.2B with a range spanning $3.2B to $39.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in AI & Software valuations at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $323M (low) to $12.8B (high), with a median of $5.8B. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median methodologies reflects the current market's extreme valuation variance in frontier AI. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, product-market validation specificity, and whether the peer set adequately reflects NextSilicon's technical differentiation or commercialization trajectory.
